start_here: Say to your AI: "Find every other place the file /Volumes/Card/DCIM/clip.mov is, on my other drives and in my Trillion space." It runs tool:trillion-media-file-places with that path and tells you each drive path and Trillion name that holds the same bytes.
no_lists_because: It reads the person's connected drives and files through the records door and keeps no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Connect the drive that holds the file and note the file's full path, for example /Volumes/Card/DCIM/clip.mov (it must be on a connected drive, not on the computer's own disk).

2. Say "Find every other place /Volumes/Card/DCIM/clip.mov is." Your AI runs tool:trillion-media-file-places through tools:run with {"path": "/Volumes/Card/DCIM/clip.mov"}; it runs on your computer and takes about 20 seconds.

3. Read the answer: places lists each drive copy (kind drive, with its path, mount and drive name) and, when your Trillion space holds the same bytes, one trillion-space place with the names it is kept under.

4. Check complete. When it is false, unreadable names the folders that could not be read, so a copy may sit there: fix their access and run it again. A 403 means the file is not on a connected drive; a 400 means you gave a folder.

worked_examples.title: One clip found on a second drive and in the Trillion space
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/work-on-connected-drives/read-data/file-places.mjs and its test test/file-places.test.mjs (its case with two drives and a Trillion name). I could not run it here: it needs a Mac with drives mounted under /Volumes. Synthetic setup: drives Card and Backup are connected; Card holds DCIM/clip.mov (1048576 bytes); Backup holds Footage/renamed.mov with the same bytes; a different file Backup/Footage/other.mov has the same size but other bytes; the Trillion space holds the identity under /Projects/clip.mov. The identity shown is a made-up 1f: plus 64 hex characters.
worked_examples.hands_back: The answer's result is {"path":"/Volumes/Card/DCIM/clip.mov","identity":"1f:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","byte_length":1048576,"places":[{"kind":"drive","path":"/Volumes/Backup/Footage/renamed.mov","mount":"/Volumes/Backup","drive":"Backup"},{"kind":"drive","path":"/Volumes/Card/DCIM/clip.mov","mount":"/Volumes/Card","drive":"Card"},{"kind":"trillion-space","identity":"1f:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","names":["/Projects/clip.mov"]}],"complete":true}. The drive places are sorted by path, other.mov is left out because its bytes differ, and the trillion-space place comes last.
